title: Odd-parameter influence identity
statement:
Let $k$ and $m$ be natural numbers with $k>0$. For $M_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$ and $Q_{m,c,j}=\binom{2m+c}{m+j}/2^{2m+c}$, the normalized total influence of the Gotsman–Linial extremizer on the $(k+2m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube satisfies
\[\frac{\operatorname{Inf}_{\mathrm{tot}}(G_{k+2m+1,k})}{\sqrt{k+2m+1}}=\sqrt{k+2m+1}\,M_m\sum_{j=0}^{k-1}\frac{Q_{m,k,j}}{M_m}.\]
